verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas documents JavaScript scripting as central: ESM `.mjs` class-based scripts are recommended, TypeScript projects can be scaffolded, scripts can be edited locally in VS Code, and scripts can be modified live while the app runs. Engine components are documented as identical across Editor scripts and standalone engine use, which implies broad API exposure. However, nothing in the pack documents a debugger, and community comments about dev-experience headaches temper the productivity claim. Missing for 10: any documented debugger (breakpoints/stepping), explicit evidence that scripts expose the full engine API beyond the physics example, independent corroboration that the modern ESM/TypeScript workflow is productive.
